name: The Overlord, watching
description: the Overlord of Hell: a giant figure of black obsidian with a crown of long black horns, burning red eyes, broad shoulders under a heavy cloak of black stone, tired and velvety, lit by lava glow from below

poses.stand: standing in profile facing left, cloak hanging, one hand on a horn of his crown, looking down
poses.laugh: head thrown back laughing, shoulders raised, one hand on his chest
poses.point: one long arm stretched out pointing down-left, the other hand open

idle.action: hovers, shoulders rising and falling slowly, red eyes glowing, the cloak stirring

point.action: points down at the hero and flicks his hand to throw

flee.action: turns his back and rises upward out of the top of the picture, cloak trailing
